implementation_notes: An sbt subproject per context; `dependsOn(...) % Compile` versus `% "compile->compile"` controls what leaks. Keep package objects free of cross-context references and verify with sbt-dependency-graph in CI.
idiom_name: sbt module with scoped compile dependencies
pitfalls: A `core` project both contexts depend on, which merges the models
Cross-context implicits in scope, making the coupling invisible
